name: Loving-kindness

cues.text: Sit comfortably. Read each phrase slowly and let it rest.
Let the phrases go and rest for a moment.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel distressed or uneasy.
You can stop at any time.
If strong feelings come up, you can open your eyes and stop.

copy.intent: Offer kind phrases to yourself, then to a friend.
copy.end: Take a moment before you move on. How are you feeling now?
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Moderate is for daily positive emotion in waitlist-controlled RCTs (Zeng 2015). Research gives no pacing; the default rate is an ambient, unguided visual only. Phrase timings are a team choice. The end check-in is required by the research. Verify before release.
